customManagers.description: The GitHub Actions runner version that sandrun-api installs in GITHUB_JOB guests.
The @openai/codex version that sandrun-api installs in OPENAI_CODEX guests.
The Node.js 24 version that sandrun-api installs in OPENAI_CODEX guests without Node.js.
The Node.js version that the SandCrew guest bridge installs for the ACP adapters.

prBodyNotes: Set the adapter version and the agent package version of the updated lockfile in `cmds/sandcrew-bridge/internal/pins/pins.json`, and check the modes, authentication and capabilities that `docs/cmds-sandcrew-bridge-foundation.md#vendors` records against the new adapter; `TestNpmLockfilesMatchPins` fails until the versions match.

Copy the sha256 values of the five archives (linux-x64 and linux-arm64 `.tar.gz`, darwin-arm64 `.tar.gz`, win-x64 and win-arm64 `.zip`) from the release's `SHASUMS256.txt` into `cmds/sandcrew-bridge/internal/pins/pins.json`, update the URLs, roots and `reportedVersion`, and set `checksumsVersion`; `TestEmbeddedPinsAreComplete` fails until then.
Copy the sha256 values of the six release archives into `runnerSHA256` and set `runnerChecksumsVersion` in `servers/sandrun-api/internal/github/install.go`; `TestRunnerChecksums` fails until then.
The OpenAI self-hosted guide installs `@openai/codex@alpha`, so this pin follows the `alpha` dist-tag. Check that `codex exec-server --help` still lists `--remote` and `--environment-id`.

Copy the sha256 values of the four `.tar.gz` archives (linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64) from the release's `SHASUMS256.txt` into `nodeSHA256` and set `nodeChecksumsVersion` in `servers/sandrun-api/internal/agent/codex/install.go`; `TestNodeChecksums` fails until then.
